frameworks.name: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
frameworks.scope: Pre-packaged commodities intended for retail sale, wholesale, or import

rules.description: Every retail package must carry specified declarations on the principal display panel.

mrp_format.text_requirement: Must state 'Maximum Retail Price' or 'MRP' and include all taxes.

rules.description: The net quantity declaration must exclude the weight of wrappers or packaging materials.
rules.allowable_error: Must conform to the statistical tolerances specified in the First and Second Schedules.

rules.description: Every wholesale package must display specific identification and quantity definitions.

frameworks.name: Legal Metrology (General) Rules, 2011
frameworks.scope: Specifications and verification of weighing and measuring instruments

rules.description: Weighing and measuring instruments must be periodically verified.

intervals.instrument_category: Weights, capacity measures, or length measures
Weighing instruments, petrol pumps, or digital indicators

rules.description: Every instrument verified must be stamped and sealed by a Legal Metrology Officer with a verification mark.
